title: Northstar synthetic plan: privacy and document handling
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. This learning application uses only the fictional documents included in its checked-in training corpus. Learners must not add real benefit statements, customer records, member names, personal health information, access credentials, or workplace data. The local prototype stores synthetic source text and derived chunks in the learner's local data directory. Deleting a source from that directory does not automatically prove that every derived vector, backup, log, or exported file has been erased; deletion scope must be inspected and recorded. Raw question and source text should not be written to application logs by default. A local-only program does not establish enterprise authorization, legal compliance, a production retention policy, or access isolation. The assistant may explain the documented local behavior but must not claim certification or compliance. This synthetic policy is itself a test input, not a replacement for official privacy or security counsel.
